release_scope: 0.1.3 reset-closing patch: each release generates its desktop acceptance record from its own verification run (the six ported games in Playwright's Chromium and Firefox builds, at the exact packaged runtime) and refuses to publish unless it passed. The game core and browser app code are unchanged from 0.1.2; there are no gameplay changes. The physical-device gate stays deferred.

desktop_acceptance.scope: The release workflow's browser jobs test the exact packaged site; tools/desktop-acceptance.py turns their results into the nocpu-X.Y.Z-acceptance.json release asset, bound to that site's runtime_sha256. It is passed only when every listed game's tagged browser tests passed in every listed engine (Playwright builds of Chromium and Firefox; Stunt Cycle and Indy 4 from the private ROM fixtures), and publishing refuses a release without it. Original/native/Wasm comparisons are recorded in docs/ACCEPTANCE.md; optional human checks there are supplementary and never replace this gate.

physical_device_gate.basis: AGENTS.md and docs/ROADMAP.md: mobile/touch UI, phone device qualification, iPhone Home Screen/PWA support and any physical-device gate are deferred to the post-accuracy phase and do not gate desktop releases. The legacy device gate is history at tag legacy-0.6.0.
